summary.text: Teresa Reilly is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 35A (Cecil and Harford counties) and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was first elected in 2014, has been a member of the House since 2015, and serves on the Health Committee and the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Teresa Reilly was born in Ohio on June 26, 1958, and graduated from Kenwood Senior High School in Essex, Maryland, in 1976, according to her General Assembly biography.
She is a former bank officer and served as chief of staff to Maryland Delegate H. Wayne Norman Jr. from 2008 to 2014.
Her biography also lists service as vice chair of the Harford County Republican Central Committee from 2002 to 2014.
Reilly served on the Ways and Means Committee from 2015 to 2019 and on the Health and Government Operations Committee from 2020 to 2025.
She has been Deputy Minority Whip since 2023, having also held that post from 2015 to 2018, and has chaired the Harford County Delegation since 2017.

Ballotpedia reports that she advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary and will face fellow Republican incumbent Mike Griffith and Democrats Gregory Anderson and Michael Eckels Jr. for the district's two seats in the general election.
